name: dragon fear
desc: When a dragonborn develops the power to instill fear in their foes, they gain the following benefits:
- Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

- Instead of exhaling destructive energy from your Breath Weapon trait, you can expend a use of that trait to roar, forcing each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier). A target automatically succeeds on the save if it can't hear or see you. On a failed save, a target becomes frightened of you for 1 minute. If the frightened target takes any damage, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.
